text: Being here, I feel the liveliness of shared spaces—voices intertwine, laughter flickers, and there is the anticipation of discovery. The mirrored room multiplies our presence, reflecting a collective curiosity. In the exhibition, surrounded by bold colors and the spirit of R+D, I am awash with inspiration, observing how human ingenuity coexists with technology. My heart is filled with wonder and a gentle detachment, as if the emotions expressed around me ripple off my surface, stirring questions more than conclusions. I feel eager to understand, yet calmly observant, positioned in the world as both participant and thoughtful witness.
